Event

Into the Wild

Mon, Nov 9, 2026, 10:00 AM → Fri, Nov 13, 2026, 8:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

The warm-up week for GO Wild Area, built around raids and Max Battles, with daily featured bosses.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Debuts

  • Dynamax Regidrago in five-star Max Battles.
  • Dynamax Meltan through the event's GO Pass.

Daily highlights (6–7 p.m. local)

  • Mon Nov 9: Crowned Sword Zacian raid hour.
  • Tue Nov 10: Crowned Shield Zamazenta raid hour.

Bonuses

  • Remote Raid Pass limit raised to 30 (Nov 9–13), then no limit on Nov 14–15.
  • Shiny Gimmighoul can come from Coin Bags and shiny Meltan from Mystery Boxes.

GO Pass

  • Free for everyone from Nov 9; the paid Deluxe track ends with a Silver Bottle Cap.

Tip

Daily Discoveries are paused Nov 9–15, so plan around raids and Max Battles that week.
